summary: Cupola cabin dated to the 1920s and abandoned in the 1940s; a hike-in site, and no source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it gone.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as Hike-In.

evidence.supports: cupola cabin built in the 1920s, abandoned in the 1940s
evidence.quote: This cupola cabin, built in the 1920's, was abandoned in the 1940's.

evidence.supports: patrol points two miles SSE and three miles north
evidence.quote: There were also patrol points 2 miles SSE and 3 miles north.

notes_for_editor: Both pages give only decades for the build and the abandonment, so no events are recorded; the story uses the decades. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the agency as Clearwater-Potlatch TPA and does not expand TPA, so the field keeps the label as printed. Neither page describes what remains today. A Clearwater National Forest lookout list PDF (fs.usda.gov/media/259185) was checked and has no Goat or Grassy entry, so it is not cited.
